Did: migration 20261025000300_phase3_briefing_questions.sql adds briefing_claims.kind ('statement'|'question', default statement) and briefing_claims.rationale, and briefings.dropped_question_count. preparation/questions.rs: Question {claim: Claim, rationale}, verify_questions (each question goes through briefing::verify like a statement, plus a non-blank rationale; the first 5 verified are kept, later verified ones are dropped as QUESTION_LIMIT; others drop as MALFORMED_QUESTION / SOURCE_NOT_INCLUDED / QUOTE_NOT_FOUND), load_questions(pool, briefing_id). briefing::run now parses {statements, questions}, returns BriefingOutcome.questions and dropped_questions, and stores both in one transaction; questions take the ordinals after the statements. load_claims filters kind='statement'. Assumptions: one citation per question rationale (source + quote), the same as statements. A reply without a 'questions' key gives zero questions; a 'questions' value that is not an array fails with PREP_PARSE_FAILED. Questions over the cap are counted in dropped_question_count with reason QUESTION_LIMIT. Questions share briefing_claims, so L1/L2 replace/delete propagation covers them with no extra work.
